name: Spark
blurb: Warm up the night — easy laughs, light touches, and a few surprises.

cards.text: What's the most-played song in your head this week? Sing the chorus, badly, right now.
cards.soften: Hum it, no words needed.

cards.text: Give the other person a hand massage for 60 seconds. No talking allowed — only hands.
cards.soften: 30 seconds, one hand.

cards.text: What's a tiny thing I do that you secretly find adorable but have never said out loud?
Staring contest. First to blink does a slow lap around the couch like a runway model.
cards.soften: First to blink just says 'you win' in a dramatic movie-trailer voice.

cards.text: Describe your dream Sunday in exactly three words. No explaining.
If we could teleport anywhere for the next 48 hours, where are we eating breakfast tomorrow morning?
Slow dance to a song in your head. Pick something embarrassing and commit to it.
cards.speak: While you dance, say the first thing you remember about our first kiss.
cards.soften: Sway together for 20 seconds, no song.

cards.text: What did you think about me the very first time we met? Honesty pays better than flattery.
Both of you: say something you appreciate about each other that happened THIS WEEK. Specific or it doesn't count.
cards.soften: One word each. The other person gets to ask why.

cards.text: Impressions battle: imitate the other person. Best impression wins a wildcard — swap any dare tonight, no cost.
cards.soften: Just pick which impression face they make most.

cards.text: What's a tradition we should invent? Ours, nobody else's, starting this week.
Feed the other person a bite of anything within arm's reach. Eye contact required.
cards.soften: Pretend-feed them. Air bites.

cards.text: Kiss them somewhere you haven't kissed them in a long time. Take your time finding the spot.
cards.soften: Kiss their forehead and tell them one thing you're proud of them for.

cards.text: Whisper in their ear the thing you've been wanting tonight. Not the plan — the feeling.
Sit back-to-back and take three slow breaths together. On the third, both say one word for how this night should end.
cards.soften: Just hold the back-to-back for 30 seconds.

cards.text: Do one tiny act of service for them right now — something that says 'I've got you' without a word. They close their eyes while you do it.
cards.soften: Tell them what you WOULD do, and schedule it for tomorrow.

cards.text: What is the silliest thing they've done lately that still makes you smile when you think about it?
Tell them one small discovery you've made about them in the past month that felt like a fun surprise.
What easy laugh do you two fall into that always feels like home?
Share a tiny moment from this week when being around them just felt lighter.
What playful side of them do you hope never goes away?
Name one ordinary thing they do that still feels quietly charming to you.
Invite a thirty-second silly face-off: try to make each other laugh without talking.
cards.soften: Share one goofy expression and see if it lands.

cards.text: Offer a quick high-five, then hold on for three extra seconds just to make it awkward-sweet.
cards.soften: Give a normal high-five and a smile.

cards.text: Invite them to swap seats or spots with you for one full minute and notice what feels different.
cards.soften: Trade places for a few seconds and comment on it.

cards.text: Lean over and whisper one genuine compliment like it's a secret.
cards.speak: I've been noticing this about you and it makes me happy.
cards.soften: Say one nice thing out loud in a normal voice.

cards.text: Offer a playful shoulder bump or gentle nudge, then stay close for a beat longer than usual.
cards.soften: Give a light friendly bump and smile.

cards.text: Invite a soft, quick kiss on the cheek or corner of the mouth, then pull back just far enough to see their reaction.
cards.soften: Blow a playful air kiss instead.

cards.text: Whisper one thing you find attractive about them right now, low enough that only they can hear.
cards.speak: This is one of the things that pulls me toward you.
cards.soften: Say the same thing in a normal quiet voice.

cards.text: Invite a ten-second forehead-to-forehead pause, eyes closed, just sharing the quiet.
cards.soften: Rest your forehead near theirs for a few seconds.

cards.text: Together, try to name five tiny things you both enjoy doing in the same room without needing a plan.
cards.soften: Each name two easy shared things you like.

cards.text: Take turns giving the other person a thirty-second shoulder or hand squeeze while saying one thing you appreciate.
cards.soften: Share a short hand squeeze and one kind word each.

cards.text: Create a quick two-item 'fun menu' together: two small playful things you could do before the day ends.
cards.soften: Each suggest one light idea and pick a favorite.

cards.text: Mirror each other's posture and expression for twenty seconds, then break into whatever laugh comes.
cards.soften: Copy one silly face the other makes.

cards.text: What is the easiest way they can make you smile on a regular day?
Share one small thing you're looking forward to doing with them soon.
What light touch or gesture from them always feels friendly and welcome?
Name a silly shared joke or reference that still works on both of you.
Talk about the kind of easy evening that leaves both of you feeling recharged instead of drained.
Share what 'playful' looks like between you when no one else is around.
What is one sleep habit of theirs that you find quietly endearing?
Tell them your current comfort-food craving and whether you'd share it with them.
What secret talent of yours have they still not fully seen in action?
If you two had a couple-superhero name, what would it be and what would your power be?
What future pet name for a possible animal companion keeps popping into your head?
Share one thing you think your friends would say is 'so you two' if they watched a regular evening at home.
What song would you put on a playlist that is secretly about them?
Describe the dream-house detail you would give them a tour of first.
What small inside joke between you still works even when the timing is terrible?
Invite them to brainstorm three possible pet names for each other and vote on the most ridiculous winner.
cards.soften: Suggest one playful pet name and see if it sticks for a minute.

cards.text: Offer to take a quick selfie together right now — serious face first, then the real smile.
cards.soften: Suggest a single candid photo if a selfie feels like too much.

cards.text: Invite a hand-holding walk around the room or down the hall for one full minute, no destination required.
cards.soften: Hold hands while standing still for twenty seconds.

cards.text: Reveal one tiny secret talent with a ten-second demonstration, no matter how useless.
cards.soften: Tell them about a small skill without the demo.

cards.text: Start a compliment-battle: trade genuine compliments back and forth until one of you laughs or runs out.
cards.soften: Give two sincere compliments and stop.

cards.text: Invite them to help you create one brand-new inside joke in under a minute — a word, face, or reference that only you two will get.
cards.soften: Suggest a silly shared phrase and see if it lands.

cards.text: Offer to queue a three-song mini playlist for them right now and play the first track if possible.
cards.soften: Name one song that makes you think of them.

cards.text: Invite a quick 'what would our friends say' round: each of you guesses the most likely comment friends would make about you as a pair.
cards.soften: Share one light guess about how friends see you two.

cards.text: Invite a warm shower-together daydream out loud: describe the most playful, steamy-but-still-fun version of sharing a shower without leaving the room.
cards.speak: If we were in there right now I'd pull you closer like this.
cards.soften: Describe a cozy shared bath or long rinse in lighter terms.

cards.text: Lean in and whisper one thing you find attractive about them in this exact moment, then stay close for three extra seconds.
cards.speak: Right now it's this about you that I can't ignore.
cards.soften: Say the same thing at normal volume with a smile.

cards.text: Offer to cook or assemble something tiny together in the next five minutes — even if it's just toast or a snack plate.
cards.soften: Suggest making a simple snack side by side.

cards.text: Invite them to show you their best 'future pet' voice or name delivery for a fictional animal.
cards.soften: Ask what they would name a future pet.

cards.text: Together, build a six-song shared playlist in five minutes: three songs each that feel like 'us' in different moods.
cards.soften: Each add one song that feels like the two of you.

cards.text: Create a couple-superhero identity together: name, powers, and one ridiculous weakness. Present it like a team announcement.
cards.soften: Each suggest a power and combine them into one fun identity.

cards.text: Take a two-photo series together: one 'serious couple' pose and one completely broken, laughing version.
cards.soften: Take one casual photo together.

cards.text: Cook or prep one small thing side by side as a team challenge — no phones, just the two of you figuring it out.
cards.soften: Assemble a simple snack together.

cards.text: Brainstorm future pet names together until you have a shortlist of five, then crown a champion.
cards.soften: Each offer two pet-name ideas and pick a favorite.

cards.text: Go on a one-minute hand-holding tour of the space you're in, pointing out one detail each as if showing a guest.
cards.soften: Walk a few steps together while holding hands.

cards.text: What comfort food would you want waiting for you after a long day?
Morning person, night person, or chaos person — where do you land this week?
What is the most recent photo of the two of you that still makes you happy?
If you could add one silly rule to the house for a day, what would it be?
What song instantly improves your mood when it comes on?
Talk about the dream-house tour you would give each other — which room first and why.
Discuss what kind of pet energy (or plant energy) would actually fit your real life together.
Share what 'gossip about us' from friends would make you both laugh the hardest.
What is the most recent inside joke that still makes both of you laugh even when the timing is terrible?
Tell them about a nostalgic song that instantly pulls up a shared memory.
What tiny anniversary of an inside joke or silly moment do you think deserves a celebration?
Share one favorite memory that still feels like it belongs on a highlight reel of the two of you.
What would your ideal midnight snack run look like if you could design every detail?
If you could vote on a future vacation right now, what destination would get your ballot?
What is one small thing from today that already feels worth remembering?
Invite a one-sentence love letter: write or speak a single sentence that captures how you feel about them right now.
cards.speak: If I only got one sentence it would be this.
cards.soften: Share one short appreciative sentence.

cards.text: Offer a karaoke-for-one moment: sing four lines of any song, seriously or terribly, no judgment allowed.
cards.soften: Hum a few bars or quote the lyrics instead.

cards.text: Invite a quick thumb-war tournament: best of three, winner gets to choose the next tiny activity.
cards.soften: Do one friendly thumb war and laugh about it.

cards.text: Propose a midnight-snack-run fantasy: describe the perfect late-night food mission the two of you would take.
cards.soften: Name one snack you wish you had right now.

cards.text: Invite them to hide a short handwritten note somewhere in the room for you to find within two minutes.
cards.soften: Write a one-line note and hand it over instead.

cards.text: Offer a two-truths-and-a-lie about your day and let them guess the lie.
cards.soften: Share two true things about your day.

cards.text: Invite a bedroom-window stargazing moment: stand or sit by the window together and point out anything that looks like a star, plane, or wish.
cards.speak: Make a wish with me even if it's just a streetlight.
cards.soften: Look out the window together for a short quiet moment.

cards.text: Lean in and create a brand-new secret handshake that includes one surprisingly soft or sweet gesture at the end.
cards.soften: Invent a simple two-move handshake.

cards.text: Invite a cooking-competition-lite: each of you invents a ridiculous three-ingredient snack and presents it like a contest entry.
cards.soften: Suggest one silly snack idea together.

cards.text: Together, build a quick pillow-fort or blanket-fort big enough for both of you and declare it home base for five minutes.
cards.soften: Pile a couple of pillows and sit in the nest together.

cards.text: Create a secret handshake together that has at least four steps and one ridiculous finishing move.
cards.soften: Invent a short two- or three-step handshake.

cards.text: Draw quick portraits of each other in under two minutes, then reveal and celebrate the results.
cards.soften: Do a ten-second stick-figure portrait each.

cards.text: Play footsie under the table or across the couch for one full minute without acknowledging it out loud.
cards.soften: Rest your feet near each other for a shorter stretch.

cards.text: What future vacation idea keeps sneaking into your daydreams?
Morning playlist, evening playlist, or chaos playlist — which one are you today?
What small comfort would make tonight feel like an automatic win?
Talk about the perfect blanket-fort movie night — film, snacks, and non-negotiable rules.
Discuss a mystery date-night plan where one of you designs everything and the other only knows the dress code.
